select u.*,m.money,v.is_vip as isVip,v.end_time as vipEndTime,i.integral_num as integralNum, (select ifnull(sum(money),0.00) from user_vip_details uvd where uvd.user_id=u.user_id) as userVipDetailsCount, (select count(*) from tb_user tb where tb.inviter_code=u.invitation_code
and date_format(tb.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(tb.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(tb.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
) as counts
,(select start_time from tearoom_user t where t.user_id=u.user_id and t.tearoom_id=#{tearoomUser}) as startTime, (select end_time from tearoom_user t where t.user_id=u.user_id and t.tearoom_id=#{tearoomUser}) as endTime, (select status from tearoom_user t where t.user_id=u.user_id and t.tearoom_id=#{tearoomUser}) as tearoomUserStatus
from tb_user u left join user_money m on m.user_id=u.user_id left join user_vip v on v.user_id=u.user_id left join user_integral i on i.user_id=u.user_id where 1=1
and FIND_IN_SET(u.user_id, (select employee_user_ids from tearoom where tearoom_id=#{tearoomUser})) > 0
and (u.user_id=#{search} or u.phone = #{search} or u.user_name like concat('%',#{search},'%') )
and u.sex=#{sex}
and u.platform=#{platform}
and u.sys_phone=#{sysPhone}
and u.status=#{status}
and date_format(u.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')>=date_format(#{sttearoom where tearoom_id=#{tearoomUser}artTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(u.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')<=date_format(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
and u.user_name like CONCAT('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.inviter_code=#{inviterCode}
and u.tearoom_id=#{tearoomId}
and u.is_rate=#{isRate}
and (u.is_rate=2 or u.is_rate is null)
and v.is_vip=1
and (v.is_vip=2 or v.is_vip=1 is null)
and u.vip_index=#{vipIndex}
and u.vip_no like concat('%',#{vipNo},'%')
and u.birthday is not null and u.vip_index>1
and u.birthday like concat('%',#{birthdayMonth},'-%')
and u.user_id in (select user_id from orders where date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')>=date_format(#{ordersStartTime},'%Y-%m-%d'))
and u.user_id in (select user_id from orders where date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')>=date_format(#{ordersEndTime},'%Y-%m-%d'))
and tearoom_id is null and zhi_rate=0 and fei_rate=0
and u.user_id in (select user_id from tearoom)
order by userVipDetailsCount desc
order by u.birthday asc
order by m.money desc
order by u.birthday asc
order by counts desc
order by i.integral_num desc
order by u.create_time desc
